turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi! How are you today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: A bit tired today, but okay.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I bought a kettlebell and I'm scared of the swing. It feels like it's going to fly through my window.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's a fair worry. The key is that the power comes from your hips, not your arms.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My hips?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Push your hips back like you're closing a car door with your bum, then snap them forward. Your arms just guide the bell.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh, also, my garden gate won't latch anymore, it just swings open.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Probably the gate has sagged a little. Would you rather adjust the hinges, or move the latch to where the gate now sits?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My mate's just sat down next to me. Couple of minutes.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sure, go ahead.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Leo, did you notice the smell in the bathroom?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Like old socks and wet dog? Yeah.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The agent said it just needs airing out.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Agents say that about everything. Did you see the black spots on the ceiling?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I thought that was shadow.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: That's damp. Ask them when the extractor fan was last checked.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And if they dodge the question?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Then we keep looking. The one on Mill Road was nicer anyway.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, finished. I'm back now.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Okay. Your garden gate. Lifting it on the hinges, or moving the latch?
